annotations.title: Quote a stamp from its words

description: Price a custom concrete stamp from the words on it. Send the lines (and optionally a font and letter height); get back the measured stamp size in inches, the exact price (the same measurement and rounding the designer and checkout use), a standard shipping estimate, how far ahead of a pour to order, any problems that would stop the order, and design_url: a link that opens exactly this design in the free 3D designer, where the person orders it. Excludes tax.

depth_inches.description: Impression depth in inches: 0.25 (standard, the default) or 0.125 for cities that specify a 1/8" impression. Same price.

font.description: Font key; default arial-rounded (the designer's default)

letter_height_inches.description: Capital-letter height in inches. Omit to use the designer's default (1.75"), stepped down in 0.25" steps to the font's floor if the stamp wouldn't otherwise have one side 46" or less and the other 94" or less.

lines.description: The stamp's words, one array entry per line (1-8 lines, each at most 60 characters). An empty string is a blank line.
